requirements.title: Fixed-Size Compile-Time Matrix Container
requirements.description: The kmat library shall provide a matrix container with compile-time-fixed dimensions.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013 and SW-REQ-SYS-050; nav uses a 16-state estimator and heap allocation is forbidden.

requirements.title: Matrix Multiplication
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute the product of two compatibly-dimensioned matrices.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix multiplication primitives.

requirements.title: Matrix Transpose
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute the transpose of a matrix.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix transpose primitives.

requirements.title: Matrix Addition
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute element-wise addition of two equally-dimensioned matrices.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix addition primitives.

requirements.title: Scalar Multiplication
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute the product of a matrix and a scalar value.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires scalar multiplication primitives.

requirements.title: Matrix Inversion
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute the inverse of a square matrix.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator gain computation requires matrix inversion.

requirements.title: Status Code on Non-Invertible Input
requirements.description: The kmat library shall return a failure status when inverting a non-invertible matrix.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; explicit status reporting on numerical failure preserves deterministic, well-defined behavior.

requirements.title: No Dynamic Memory Allocation
requirements.description: The kmat library shall perform no dynamic memory allocation in any operation.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-050; matrix operands and results are caller-owned stack or static storage.

requirements.title: Deterministic Numeric Results
requirements.description: The kmat library shall produce identical numeric results for identical input values on a given build.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic FSW outputs require deterministic underlying matrix math.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Numeric Equivalence
requirements.description: The kmat library shall produce numerically equivalent results on POSIX and Pico2 builds within IEEE-754 rounding limits.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation must exercise the same math paths as the flight build.

requirements.title: No Runtime Polymorphism
requirements.description: The kmat library shall not employ runtime polymorphism in any matrix operation.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-051; math primitives are statically dispatched after initialization.

requirements.title: Unit Test Line Coverage
requirements.description: The kmat library unit tests shall achieve 100 percent line coverage of library source files.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-054; the FSW-wide 100% line coverage mandate applies to kmat.

requirements.title: Matrix Subtraction
requirements.description: The kmat library shall compute element-wise subtraction of two equally-dimensioned matrices.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-013; nav 16-state estimator math requires matrix subtraction primitives.

requirements.title: No Runtime Type Information
requirements.description: The kmat library shall not use runtime type information.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-052; RTTI is prohibited FSW-wide and enforced via -fno-rtti.

requirements.title: No Thrown Exceptions
requirements.description: The kmat library shall not throw C++ exceptions.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-053; exceptions are prohibited FSW-wide and enforced via -fno-exceptions.
